Bharat Taxi launches in Chandigarh with zero commission model

Bharat Taxi, a new ride-hailing service, has launched in Chandigarh. The service operates with zero commission for drivers and no surge pricing for customers. Drivers are also being offered an ownership stake in the company. This launch comes after Ola and Uber were reportedly banned in the city. Bharat Taxi plans to expand to three other cities in Punjab.
